a) It is a wage employment scheme fully funded by Government of Tamil Nadu

The farmers have to be sustained in agriculture sector by increasing their net income and thereby improving their livelihood and economic status. Drying the agricultural produce in hygienic condition and in lesser time is the biggest challenge faced by farmers. addresses the above challenges faced in drying.

SOCIAL MEDIA

The announcements of the Hon’ble Chief

Minister, schemes and achievements of the

Government, awareness news of the Government

are disseminated through Social Media like Twitter

and Facebook from 7.5.2021 and Instagram from

24.6.2021 and in YouTube from 30.6.2021.

13

PHOTO SECTION

The photographers in the Photo Section in the Secretariat take photographs in Government functions honoured by the President of India, Hon’ble Vice President, Hon’ble Prime Minister, Hon’ble Chief Minister, and the Hon’ble Ministers for releasing them to the print media. The photographers in the District PRO offices take photographs in Government functions in the districts by co-ordinating with the office of the District Collectors.

The photographs taken by photographers in Secretariat, Chennai are mailed to the media personnel through the Press Release Section. Selected photographs are displayed in the display panel in the Secretariat as well as in the Tamil Nadu House, New Delhi. Photographs taken in the districts are sent to the print media in their districts. Selected photographs are displayed in the display panels in the district collectors’ office and used for displaying in mini exhibitions conducted during important Government functions.

14

Photos relating to the launching of new

schemes by the Hon’ble Chief Minister are also

published in Tamilarasu, publications both in Tamil

and English, achievement issues of Tamilarasu

and in Coffee Table Book.

Photos taken in Government functions are

preserved as documents in CDs and Hard Disks

for future reference.

15

REFERENCE SECTION

The Reference Section functioning under the Information and Public Relations Department brings to the notice of the Government every day important news items carried by all newspapers, periodicals and upcountry newspapers, department wise, by categorizing them.

The Reference section consolidates the news clippings of important news items from dailies, periodicals, and upcountry newspapers and submits them daily in the morning and the evening for the perusal of the Hon’ble Chief Minister in file format. News clippings are also sent to the Chief Secretary and Secretaries to Government for their perusal and necessary action.

In addition, complaints and adverse news published on various Government departments are scanned and sent to the their respective Secretaries, Heads of Departments and the district collectors through WhatsApp and the feedback received is sent to the media for publication. Important Tamil and English

16

newspapers are preserved as bound volumes for future reference. They are made available during legislature sessions and to the offices of the Hon’ble Chief Minister, Hon’ble Ministers, and Secretaries to Government as per their request.
